caption: This drawing features a rectangular composition divided into three horizontal bands. The top and bottom bands have a similar pattern consisting of small pinkish-red flowers with green leaves, set against a beige background with intricate swirling designs. The central band is wider and showcases two large, detailed, multi-petaled flowers in shades of cream, pink, and red, with green leaves that have brownish shading, all placed against a light beige background filled with small dotted patterns. The colors are primarily muted earth tones, including greens, pinks, reds, creams, and beiges. At the bottom right of the central band, the name "Geo Loughridge" is inscribed. The drawing is bordered by a wide plain margin in light beige.
title: Chintz
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
